dedupe_keys.name: electricity and natural gas tariffs at the 100 largest us wastewater treatment plants

description: This dataset holds the electricity tariffs of the 100 largest wastewater treatment plants in the US Clean Watersheds Needs Survey, and the natural gas tariffs of the 54 of them with on-site cogeneration, collected by hand from each utility's website and checked by the authors. Files give facility metadata with survey identifiers and existing and design flows, the rate schedules, billing assumptions, a reference list and synthetic energy data for a sample simulation. Coverage is the United States, with tariffs current as of November 2021. The data are a free download from figshare under CC BY 4.0 as Excel and CSV files, with Python scripts on GitHub. Caveats: tariffs change over time, so the values describe late 2021, and only the largest plants are covered. Simulation uses: energy cost and demand-flexibility optimisation for wastewater treatment operations and energy-recovery investment planning. Related records: California wastewater treatment unit processes (data-california-wwtp-unit-processes-permits-cwns) and treatment unit process costs (data-wastewater-treatment-unit-processes-removal-costs).
